# SvoCraft

> SvoCraft - милитари Minecraft-сервер с ивентовыми событиями, мини-играми, собственным лаунчером и косметикой.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://svocraft.xyz/) - overview of the server, game modes, launcher entry points, community links, and current player-facing calls to action.
- [Launcher downloads](https://svocraft.xyz/downloads) - platform downloads for the SvoCraft launcher.
- [Wiki](https://svocraft.xyz/wiki/) - player documentation and onboarding materials.
- [Getting started](https://svocraft.xyz/wiki/getting-started.html) - first steps for new players.
- [Shop](https://svocraft.xyz/shop) - cosmetic items and project support purchases.
- [Contacts](https://svocraft.xyz/contacts) - official community, support, and social links.
- [Legal documents](https://svocraft.xyz/legal) - public offer, user agreement, privacy policy, refund policy, and project rules.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Primary language: Russian.
- The public website describes a Minecraft community server and account/launcher flow.
- Private account areas such as profile, inventory, wallet, token, and admin pages should not be treated as public documentation.
- For current gameplay announcements and events, prefer official Discord and Telegram links listed above.
